about_the_game:
Evil Dark:

This first-person survival horror game will test your instinct in a realm where shadows kill and every step you take can be your last. Lurking just beyond the glow are the spawns of hell itself, and they're waiting for you to slip into darkness. Survival until dawn...or risk everything on a dangerous ritual that could banish all evil for good.

Features:

Light Is Life - Stay in lit areas of candles, lanterns, and lamps to hold darkness at bay. Stray too far and too long into the shadows, and only your death is certain.

Two Paths To Victory - Either endure the night until sunrise, or take your chances in a high-risk ritual to destroy the evil forever.

New Challenges Every Game - Each session guarantees a randomly chosen handcrafted map. Loot & danger shift every time, ensuring freshness for prolonged hours of gameplay.

Atmospheric Horror - An immersive soundscape combined with psychological tensions & chilling visuals guarantees organic building fear. Jumpscares are scarce, the terror lies within other forces in the world.

Survival Gameplay - Manage your stamina and limited light sources as you navigate through eerie and unpredictable labyrinth-like environments.

Uncover the Dark Story - Gather enough information to piece together the aftermath of a black magic ritual gone horribly wrong that led you here in the first place.

I’m a solo developer working on Evil Dark with everything I’ve got. Your feedback and support mean the world to me, and I want this passion project of mine to grow with the community. Thank you for helping bring this nightmare to life, and good luck, you'll need it. ;-]

content_descriptors.notes: This game is meant to scare you, those who are afraid of horror or jumpscares should not play this game.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ (64-bit), SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (3.2 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card with support for DirectX-compatible audio.
  • VR Support: Not supported.
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended alongside stereo speakers or headphones.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ (64-bit), SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intell Core i5-9600K (3.7 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super (6 GB VRAM) or AMD RX 590
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card with support for DirectX-compatible audio.
  • VR Support: Not supported.
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended alongside stereo speakers or headphones.
